limits: Remote PR scope is open PRs including drafts. Closed work is searched through local READMEs, TASK metadata and ledger only. Local coverage compares searched working-tree notes with regular note paths at coverage.local.head; it does not certify HEAD contents or historical coverage. No code diffs or arbitrary package files are searched. Recheck relevant heads before submission.
scope_separation: That claim bounds preserving edges and endpoint degrees; this study bounds jointly reachable future-pair XOR support. Neither condition is assumed to dominate the other.
dedup_limit: No competing exact reachable-tail pair envelope identified in inspected metadata/notes. Arbitrary diffs, unpublished work and all closed PR bodies were not fully searched. Literal numeric terms generated unrelated matches and were manually filtered.

final_targeted_refresh.scope: Latest Discussion4903 comments, exact PR4992/5000 states and recent 100 open PR metadata; not a second complete remote census.
